title: Channels
subtitle: Look up by @handle, channel name or ID; suspend / restore channels. Refreshes every 30 seconds.

search.label: Find a channel
search.placeholder: Enter a @handle, channel name or ID

table.caption: Channels by handle. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to open the details.

detail.label: Channel details
detail.placeholder: Pick a channel in the list to see its details.

suspend.title: Suspend the channel {{name}}?
suspend.body: A running broadcast ends right away, chat becomes read-only, the channel disappears from Browse and Search and upcoming schedules are cancelled. Suspensions have no end date.

restore.title: Restore the channel {{name}}?
restore.body: The channel shows up in Browse and Search again and the creator can go live.
